data.title: No Place to Hide: Event Pass (January 20-February 9)
data.meta_title: No Place to Hide: Event Pass (January 20-February 9)
data.content:
The No Place to Hide Event Pass turns every encounter into a hunt. From precision strikes to relentless pursuit, it delivers gear designed to trap, disrupt, and finish enemies.

Running from January 20 to February 9, this Event Pass brings Stormpike weapons, Crix War Robot Modules, and Hero Pilot Giancarlo—plus stylish customizations—to help you dominate every encounter in style.

No Place to Hide: Event Pass Rewards (Free & Premium)

Unleash Crix, a flanker War Robot built for disruption and pursuit. Strike with Stormpike, a light arc cannon that punishes enemies at range, and control the battlefield with Minefield (Cycle Gear).

Collect Wraps and Stickers, and recruit Giancarlo, a Hero Pilot whose cybernetic enhancements grant precision and faster reloads. His Ace Talent – Free Acceleration lets him Dash or Vault without using fuel.

The Event Pass is available for 325 Warp Reals, granting access to all premium rewards and progression.

Show off your style with Wraps and Stickers to mark your dominance on the battlefield.

Gear up your hangar, Pilots. The hunt begins January 20.
